thread:
nina: Heads-up: EU-residency cutover planned tomorrow 09:00 UTC for tenant cohort A. Need a short, operational playbook focusing on hard-residency enforcement and auditability.

raj: Can we treat this as two classes: residency=strict (no cross-region), residency=prefer (reads allowed fallback)? We should bake that into tenant config and the proxy.

claire: Agree. Suggest config entry `residency_mode: strict|prefer|off`. Strict => reject non-EU writes and never retry outside EU. Prefer => prefer EU but allow read fallback with flagging.

ben: Operational steps I propose: 1) Prewarm EU caches for listed tenants 30m before start. 2) Staged traffic ramp 10%/40%/100% with health gates. 3) Pause non-EU async workers for strict tenants for 10m drain.

luis: For enforcement: proxy reads X-Redwood-Region-Prefer and tenant.residency_mode. Behavior: if strict and chosen_region != eu -> fail fast (409) and emit audit event. If prefer and chosen_region != eu -> allow read but tag response and emit audit.

claire: Pseudo-rule: `if tenant.residency_mode=='strict' and route_region!='eu': emit_audit(); return 409`. Keep code small and deterministic.

nina: Compliance wants a CSV export of any cross-region events within 24h, fields: tenant_id,event_ts,orig_region,actual_region,action. compliance-bot can schedule.

compliance-bot: scheduled export created: cutover-2743210000-export. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/cutovers/2743210000

ben: Rollback trigger thresholds: error-rate >0.4% for 5m or p99 latency >2s sustained. Rollback command: `redwood-cli cutover rollback --id 2743210000 --force`. Keep it in runbook.

raj: Also add a KV-cache sweep step if miss rate spikes >10% during a step. Prewarm command example: `./prewarm --tenant $TID --region eu --modes kv,model`.

luis: Background jobs: `jobctl pause --tenant $TID --region non-eu --drain 600`. Ensure queue metadata carries tenant residency so workers can route properly.

nina: Owner assignments: nina legal/exec, raj proxy changes, ben observability + runbook, claire prewarm + job pause, luis audit wiring. We'll post final CSV 30m before. Ping me for urgent needs.
